The '''Sevetta sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The [[Woldona system/Legends|Woldona system]] and the planet [[Kowak/Legends|Kowak]] were in this sector.
